### REQ-016: Deliver discovery/status/config reliably after MQTT connect

## Requirement

`MqttClient::publish()` drops messages while disconnected (`net/thermo_mqtt.cpp:210-213`). `Thermo::setup()` runs inside `initSystem()` (`main.cpp:441-442`) **before** `MqttClient::connect()` (`main.cpp:520`), so its publishes are always dropped — most importantly the `info/new` **discovery** message for unconfigured devices (`core/thermo.cpp:54, 227-230`). `app_main` re-sends only `sendStatus()` after connect, never discovery or config → factory-fresh devices never register with the provisioning backend. Legacy code (`src/main.cpp:196-235`) connected WiFi + MQTT before constructing `Thermo`, so discovery was sent on a live connection.

Fix options (choose one):
1. Reorder `app_main`: run `thermoInstance->setup()` after the MQTT-connected wait (subscriptions are already queued-safe; only publishes are lossy).
2. Re-send discovery + initial status + config from the `MQTT_EVENT_CONNECTED` path (covers broker restarts too).
3. Buffer publishes while disconnected (esp-mqtt outbox handles QoS>0 if enqueued via the client even when offline).

Option 2 is the most robust (also heals the case where the broker restarts and the retained/session state is lost).

See finding F-4 in `doc/reports/2026-07-02_migration_code_review.md`.
